Boundaries.Name: standalone-read-selection
Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the caller owner through selection and ROLE validation. Count rejected candidates once and retain retries through later reply conversion.

Boundaries.Name: standalone-dedicated-read-selection
Boundaries.Contract: Borrow caller retries through dedicated candidate acquisition and cleanup; establishment and ROLE must not independently count the same failure.

Boundaries.Name: standalone-cursor-read-selection
Boundaries.Contract: Keep cursor selection failures with the enclosing caller, including fresh-cursor reselection.
